newsitem.title: CANADA: Talisman to focus on exploration.
newsitem.headline: Talisman to focus on exploration.

text.p: Talisman Energy Inc, which failed in a hostile takeover bid for Wascana Energy Inc earlier this year, said on Wednesday it would focus this year on exploration and development in its core operating areas.
Talisman Chief Executive Jim Buckee told reporters after the annual meeting that the company would increase capital spending by 60 percent this year to between C$850 million and C$900 million.
He said Talisman would try to increase average production to 205,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day this year from 171,000 BOE a day in 1996.
Buckee said the company did not plan to pursue any acquisition opportunities in the near future, but would take notice if the opportunity was right.
Talisman is forecasting that cash flow will rise by 15 percent this year to about C$800 million or C$7 to C$7.50 a share.
